import pandas as pd

don = pd.read_csv('don_hang.csv')
ct = pd.read_csv('chi_tiet_don.csv')

# parse date
don['Ngày'] = pd.to_datetime(don['Ngày'])

# June 2025
mask = (don['Ngày'] >= '2025-06-01') & (don['Ngày'] <= '2025-06-30')
don_jun = don[mask].copy()
print("Orders in June 2025:", len(don_jun))
print("Status in June 2025:")
print(don_jun['Tình trạng'].value_counts(dropna=False))

# Exclude cancelled and returned (keep completed + shipping)
don_jun = don_jun[don_jun['Tình trạng'].isin(['completed','shipping'])].copy()
print("\nOrders counting (completed+shipping):", len(don_jun))

# Join line items
joined = ct.merge(don_jun[['Mã chứng từ','Customer ID','Ngày','Tình trạng']], left_on='Mã đơn hàng', right_on='Mã chứng từ')
print("\nLine items joined:", len(joined))

# Sum Amount by customer
rev = joined.groupby('Customer ID')['Amount'].sum()
# drop null customers (khách lẻ)
rev = rev.dropna()
rev = rev.sort_values(ascending=False)
print("\nTop 10 customers by revenue in June 2025:")
print(rev.head(10))
